list.title: Projects
list.text: Projects from RitsuFlow. Configure field operations and daily reporting for each project.
setup.title: FieldOp Setup
overview.infoText: Read-only information from the canonical RitsuFlow project.
overview.readinessText: Configure the information FieldOp will use to structure daily reporting.
overview.stepActivities: Bring contracted Scope Items into FieldOp or add field-specific activities manually.
overview.stepLocations: Choose the project locations available in the field.
overview.stepWorkforce: Define the people and crews available to the project.
overview.stepSettings: Define report behavior and project-specific requirements.
activities.text: Choose which contracted Scope Items are available for field execution and Daily Reports.
activities.emptyText: Import contracted items from RitsuFlow Scope Management or add a field-specific activity manually.
activities.deactivatedText: Hidden from the field. Their location allocations and production history are kept.
activities.confirmDelete: Remove "{name}" from FieldOp? It is not used anywhere yet, so it will be deleted. The Project Scope item is not affected.
activities.confirmDeactivate: "{name}" is already in use ({uses}). It will be deactivated: hidden from the field, with its allocations and production history kept. Continue?
import.text: Select contracted Scope Items that should be available in FieldOp.
import.empty: No item-level Project Scope records were found.
import.confirmDeactivate: {count} of the unticked activities are already in use: {names}. They will be deactivated and their history kept. Continue?
manual.title: Add Manual Field Activity
manual.text: Create a FieldOp-only activity when the field needs something that is not part of the contracted Project Scope.
manual.name: Activity Name
locations.text: Choose which project locations are available in the field. Only ticked locations are used for field execution and Daily Report production.
locations.emptyText: Create the Location Structure first, then return here to enable locations for FieldOp.
workforce.text: Assign registered company workers to this project or add project-specific workers for FieldOp and Daily Reports.
workforce.emptyTitle: No workers are available to this project yet.
workforce.emptyText: Assign a registered worker or add someone manually.
workforce.assignText: Project assignment keeps company, trade, role and crew context without creating another worker record.
workforce.errEndBeforeStart: End Date cannot be earlier than Start Date.
workforce.errOrganizationUnknown: Unable to determine the Project or Worker organization.
workforce.errOrganizationMismatch: Worker and Project must belong to the same organization.
workforce.errDuplicate: This worker already has an active or scheduled assignment for this project.
workforce.confirmEnd: End {name}'s assignment to this project? Attendance history will be preserved.
workforce.manualText: Add a project-specific worker without creating a canonical Workforce Registry record.
workforce.confirmRemoveManual: Remove this manual worker from this FieldOp project?
settings.text: Define what this project's Daily Report captures and how reports move through the field workflow.
settings.loadingText: Configure project-specific Daily Report behavior without changing the canonical project record.
settings.contentText: Select the information available when a Daily Report is created.
settings.weatherText: Record weather conditions affecting field production.
settings.workforceText: Capture workers, crews and labor used during the day.
settings.progressText: Report work performed, quantities and production progress.
settings.equipmentText: Record equipment used, availability and relevant downtime.
settings.materialsText: Capture material deliveries, use and field observations.
settings.occurrencesText: Register safety, quality, delay and other field occurrences.
settings.photosText: Allow photographic evidence to be attached to the report.
settings.notesText: Provide a project-level narrative for the reporting day.
settings.workflowText: Define controls required before the report is considered complete.
settings.signatureText: Require a field signature before the Daily Report is completed.
settings.approvalText: Send submitted reports through an approval step.
settings.rulesText: Set the operational rule used for the reporting day.
settings.cutoffText: Default time used to close the field reporting day.
settings.footer: These settings apply only to this project in FieldOp.
